models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_articles
models.description:
Primary article content management table.

Stores the core content of articles including title, body, and metadata.
Each article belongs to a specific channel and section, and is created by a
member. Articles support soft deletion for content recovery and maintain
audit trail through snapshots.

Articles can have multiple tags and attachments, and are the subject of
comments. The table includes fields for tracking creation, modification,
and deletion times to support content lifecycle management.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Channel where the article is published. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_channels.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_section_id
foreignFields.description: Section within the channel where the article is categorized. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_sections.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the article. Used for display in listings and search results.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main content of the article. Contains the detailed information and analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was created. Used for sorting and filtering.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was last modified. Used for tracking changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was soft-deleted. Null if the article is active.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_snapshots
models.description:
Historical states of articles for audit trails and version control.

Stores point-in-time copies of article content to preserve historical
information. Each snapshot captures the complete state of an article at a
specific moment, including all fields from the main article table. This
allows for tracking changes over time and recovering previous versions if
needed.

Snapshots are created whenever an article is modified and are never
deleted or modified after creation. They provide a complete audit trail of all
changes to articles.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the article at the time of this snapshot.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Content of the article at the time of this snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created. Represents the point-in-time state of the article.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was last modified before this snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was soft-deleted at the time of this snapshot. Null if the article was active.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_tags
models.description:
Tags associated with articles for categorization and search.

Stores tags that describe the content of articles, enabling better
categorization and search functionality. Each tag is associated with one
or more articles, allowing for flexible content organization.

Tags are used to improve search results and help users find relevant
articles based on their interests. The table maintains a many-to-many
relationship with articles through a junction table.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article that this tag is associated with. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_articles.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the tag. Used for display and search functionality.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the tag was created. Used for tracking when tags were added to articles.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comments
models.description:
User comments on articles in the economic/political discussion board.

Stores user-generated content that engages with articles, allowing for discussion and debate. Each comment is associated with a specific article and created by an authenticated member or moderator through their active session.

Comments can be nested to support threaded discussions, and they can be edited or deleted by their authors. The comment content includes a body field for the text of the comment.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing content moderation. Comments can be flagged for review by moderators.

The comment system supports:
- Threaded discussions through parent_id field
- User authentication tracking through member/moderator relationships
- Content moderation through deleted_at and flagged fields
- Historical tracking through snapshot tables
- Soft delete capability for content management

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article that this comment belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_articles.id}

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who created the comment. Valid values: 'member' or 'moderator'

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Text content of the comment

plainFields.name: flagged
plainFields.description: Whether the comment has been flagged for moderator review

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was created

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was last updated

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was soft-deleted (null if active)

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comment_snapshots
models.description:
Historical snapshots of comments for audit trails and change tracking.

Stores point-in-time states of comments to maintain a complete history of all changes made to comments. Each snapshot captures the complete state of a comment at a specific moment in time, including the comment content, author information, and timestamps.

Snapshots are created whenever a comment is created, updated, or deleted. They provide a complete audit trail for content moderation and user accountability.

The snapshot system supports:
- Complete historical tracking of all comment changes
- Restoration of previous comment states if needed
- Content moderation through historical review
- User accountability through author tracking
- Change tracking for content analysis

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Comment that this snapshot belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_comments.id}

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who created the comment. Valid values: 'member' or 'moderator'

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Text content of the comment

plainFields.name: flagged
plainFields.description: Whether the comment was flagged for moderator review at this point in time

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was created

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the comment was last updated

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_attachments
models.description:
File and image attachments for articles and comments in the economic/political discussion board.

Stores all file attachments including images, documents, and other media types
associated with articles and comments. Each attachment is linked to either an
article or a comment through polymorphic ownership. The system supports soft
deletion to allow for content moderation while maintaining audit trails.

Attachments are created by users (members or moderators) and include metadata
such as file type, size, and upload timestamp. The attachment content is stored
in the file system with the database containing only references to these files.

The attachment system supports versioning through snapshots, allowing for the
preservation of historical states of attachments. This is particularly useful for
content moderation and historical analysis.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Article that this attachment belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Comment that this attachment belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_comments.id}

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who created the attachment. Valid values: 'member', 'moderator'.

plainFields.name: file_path
plainFields.description: Path to the stored file in the file system.

plainFields.name: file_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf').

plainFields.name: file_size
plainFields.description: Size of the file in bytes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was soft-deleted. Null if the attachment is active.

models.name: economic_political_discussion_board_attachment_snapshots
models.description:
Historical snapshots of file and image attachments in the economic/political discussion board.

Stores point-in-time states of attachments for audit trails and version control.
Each snapshot captures the state of an attachment at a specific moment, including
metadata and file references. This allows for the preservation of historical
states of attachments, which is essential for content moderation and
historical analysis.

Snapshots are created automatically whenever an attachment is created or
updated. They are immutable and cannot be modified or deleted, ensuring the
integrity of the audit trail. Each snapshot is linked to the original attachment
and includes a timestamp indicating when the snapshot was taken.

foreignFields.name: economic_political_discussion_board_attachment_id
foreignFields.description: Attachment that this snapshot belongs to. {@link economic_political_discussion_board_attachments.id}

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who created the attachment. Valid values: 'member', 'moderator'.

plainFields.name: file_path
plainFields.description: Path to the stored file in the file system.

plainFields.name: file_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf').

plainFields.name: file_size
plainFields.description: Size of the file in bytes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created.
